citation: Fama, E. F., & French, K. R. (1993). Common risk factors in the returns on stocks and bonds. Journal of Financial Economics, 33(1), 3-56. Data: https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html
point_in_time_caveat: Ken French factors are reconstructed from the current CRSP database and are not a literal point-in-time vintage. This benchmark therefore tests model behaviour on a research panel, not live tradability.
units: decimal excess returns (0.01 == 1%); RF is a decimal total return
